column2: A shaggy, horned grazer of the Ossus marshes. Mud yak herds root up river plants with their downswept horns and scatter at the first sign of danger.
A four-legged reptile named for its harsh, squawking cry. Kirruks hunt in packs, and the Ysanna have long trained them to carry riders.
A hairless little rodent of the forest canopy. Friendly, but a frightened gokob sprays a foul mist. Before the academy fell, gokobs raided its kitchens.
A big, brightly coloured frog of the regrown forests. Academy pilots once told of its sticky tongue plucking a small training starfighter out of the air.
A small two-legged reptavian, part reptile and part bird, that moves through the undergrowth in herds.
A chirping insect whose calls fill the Ossus forests. Kaddyr bugs gather in small swarms.
